sections.title: Height-Adjustable Needles and Nitrogen Efficiency
body: A fixed needle height works fine at the start of an evaporation run and wastes gas by the end of it, once the sample level has dropped well below where the needle sits.

XS-Vap's needles adjust to the actual level in each vial, keeping the nitrogen stream close to the liquid surface throughout the run rather than blasting empty headspace as evaporation progresses. That single adjustment is what delivers both confirmed savings together: up to 30% faster evaporation and up to 50% less nitrogen. The supply side reinforces it further, an independent nitrogen line running at just 1.5 to 3 bar through its own dedicated control valve, rather than a shared, unregulated gas line.

longForm.heroLead: Most parallel evaporators assume every vial is the same size. puriVap-6 doesn't make that assumption. Independent aluminum adapters fix to any position on their own, so vials of genuinely different sizes evaporate side by side in the same run, 2 mL to 60 mL each. An integrated window keeps the process visible throughout, making it easy to adjust the needle and nitrogen flow while limiting the risk of sample splashes. Each needle's height adjusts to match its own vial's sample level, for efficient evaporation and reduced nitrogen use, fed by an independent supply at just 1 to 2 bar through its own control valve. Heating reaches 100°C via an aluminum block, climbing at 4°C per minute, so you're not waiting long to get started.

sections.title: Evaporator puriVap-6 at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate puriVap-6: how independent adapters enable mixed vessel sizes, how the heating block and nitrogen supply work together, how it compares to XS-Vap, and Inkarp installation and service support.
sections.subheading: Six positions, six different vial sizes if you need them. Each adapter works independently.
body: Mixed vessel sizes run together, genuinely. Independent aluminum adapters per position, not a fixed rack that assumes uniformity.
The window does more than show you the sample. It's specifically described as easing needle and nitrogen adjustment, and reducing splash risk.
Heating uses a different mechanism than its sibling. An aluminum block here, reaching 100°C at a confirmed 4°C per minute, versus XS-Vap's water bath at 90°C.
Nitrogen efficiency uses the same core idea as XS-Vap, at different numbers. Height-adjustable needles, but a tighter 1-2 bar supply pressure rather than 1.5-3 bar.
This is the smaller-scale sibling, by both position count and volume range. 6 positions and up to 60 mL, versus XS-Vap's 90 positions and up to 250 mL.
Time and nitrogen savings aren't quantified here the way they are on XS-Vap's page. The mechanism is the same; the specific percentages aren't restated, so none are assumed.
It's built to sit close at hand. Compact enough to fit underneath a ventilation system without disrupting your bench layout.

sections.eyebrow: Mixed Vessel Sizes and Visual Monitoring
sections.title: Mixed Vessel Sizes and Visual Monitoring
body: Two things make puriVap-6 practical for varied sample batches: adapters that don't force uniformity, and a window that does real work beyond just letting you see inside.

Each position's aluminum adapter fixes independently of the others, so a run doesn't need every vial to be the same size, a genuine flexibility XS-Vap's own page doesn't confirm. The integrated window supports that flexibility directly: it makes adjusting each position's needle and nitrogen flow easier to see and manage, and it specifically reduces the risk of sample splashes during the process, not just the risk of not noticing a problem.
